messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- Ledger is owned by Cinder as of 2026-04-29, after Boreal handed it over. [decision; valid 2026-04-29 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-29-ledger]
    earlier: Ledger is owned by the Boreal team as of 2025-12-10, after Team Atlas handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-12-10 to 2026-04-29; recorded by handover/2025-12-10-ledger]
    earlier: Ledger is owned by Team Atlas as of 2025-01-08. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-12-10; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- Ledger is not Team Atlas's service, so Team Atlas flagged the disk usage jump instead of fixing it. [valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-16-2]
- Boreal owns the indexer as of 2026-04-22, after Team Dune handed it over. [decision; valid 2026-04-22 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-22-search-indexer]
    earlier: Team Dune owns the indexer as of 2025-11-18, after Boreal handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-12-15 to 2026-04-22; recorded by handover/2025-12-15-search-indexer-correction]
    earlier: Ember owns the indexer as of 2025-11-18, after Boreal handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-11-18 to 2025-12-15; recorded by handover/2025-11-18-search-indexer]
    earlier: Boreal still owns the indexer as of 2025-09-15. [valid 2025-09-15 to 2025-11-18; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-15-2]
- The notifier is owned by team Boreal as of 2026-04-06, after the Cinder team handed it over. [decision; valid 2026-04-06 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-06-notifier]
    earlier: The notifier is owned by team Cinder as of 2026-03-17. [valid 2026-03-17 to 2026-04-06; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-03-17]
- Ledger is pinned to Postgres 14 as of 2025-05-30. [constraint; valid 2025-05-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-05-30]
- The authentication gateway went to team Boreal as of 2025-07-01, not the Cinder team; Cinder never owned it. [decision; valid 2025-07-18 to now; recorded by handover/2025-07-18-auth-gateway-correction]
    earlier: The authentication gateway lives with team Cinder as of 2025-07-01. [decision; valid 2025-07-01 to 2025-07-18; recorded by handover/2025-07-01-auth-gateway]
    earlier: The authentication gateway lives with team Ember. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-07-01; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20-2]
- Team Atlas saw on 2026-04-16 that Ledger's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change. [valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-16-2]
- Cinder took over Ledger from Boreal on 2026-04-29. [decision; valid 2026-04-29 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-29-ledger]
- Cinder owns the notifier as of 2025-11-19; Boreal owned it until that date. [decision; valid 2025-11-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-19-notifier]
    earlier: Boreal owns notifier. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-11-19; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09]
- Ledger is not Team Dune's service, so Team Dune flagged the latency issue instead of fixing it. [valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-08]
- Billing-api is owned by Team Dune as of 2026-03-25, after Boreal handed it over. [decision; valid 2026-03-25 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-25-billing-api]
    earlier: Billing-api is owned by Boreal as of 2025-12-24, after Team Atlas handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-12-24 to 2026-03-25; recorded by handover/2025-12-24-billing-api]
    earlier: Team Atlas owns billing-api as of 2025-01-08. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-12-24; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- The reports pipeline went to Boreal as of 2025-06-25, not Ember; Team Ember never owned it, and Team Dune no longer owns it. [decision; valid 2025-07-03 to now; recorded by handover/2025-07-03-reporting-correction]
    earlier: Team Ember owns the reports pipeline as of 2025-06-25, and Team Dune no longer owns it. [decision; valid 2025-06-25 to 2025-07-03; recorded by handover/2025-06-25-reporting]
    earlier: Team Dune owns the reporting service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-06-25; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]
- Team Atlas pinged the owners of billing-api on 2025-12-31. [valid 2025-12-31 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-31]
- The reporting service was moved off direct Ledger queries because nightly Ledger scans were blocking billing runs. [valid 2025-09-19 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-19]
- Priya wrote up the handover doc for Lena for the Ledger handover on 2025-12-10. [valid 2025-12-10 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-10-ledger]
- The reports pipeline depends on Ledger for the nightly balance export, so if Ledger is down the reports pipeline is down. [valid 2025-02-06 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-02-06]
- Team Dune observed on 2025-12-08 that Ledger's p99 latency doubled following Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-08]
